notes.title: Day 1 patch
notes.content:
Hello everyone and thank you very much for your support!
Please if you have any suggestions or if you find any problem write me in the discussion section.

-Fixed a bug where the game was not saved correctly when moving to the next day.

-Fixed a bug where the mouse was not shown in the text of the first day.

Thank you all very much!
